description: Source code for GPIO driver for the AndesTech ATCGPIO100 controller, including register definitions, configuration functions, interrupt handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_config
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin as input or output, sets initial state, and handles debounce settings.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw input data from GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins simultaneously with masking.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages callback registration for GPIO events.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_port_get_dir
methods.description: Gets direction (input/output) of GPIO port pins.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for GPIO port, clears interrupt status and fires callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_atcgpio100_init
methods.description: Initializes GPIO device, disables interrupts, clears status, configures device, and enables IRQ.
